tools.name: price
tools.description: Use when you need a trustworthy USD price for crypto assets (ETH, BTC, cbBTC, SOL, LINK, AAVE, stablecoins), fiat FX rates (EUR, GBP, JPY…) or metals (XAU, XAG): reads the Chainlink price feed contracts directly from Base or Ethereum in one multicall and returns price, last update time, age in secon

tools.name: token
tools.description: Use when you have a token contract address and need to know what it is: reads name, symbol, decimals and totalSupply straight from the contract (one multicall) on Base or Ethereum, confirms there is contract code at the address, and adds a Chainlink USD price when one exists for the symbol. Answers

tools.name: balances
tools.description: Use when you need what a wallet or contract holds: reads the native ETH balance and ERC-20 balances (a default set of major tokens, or up to 20 token symbols/addresses you pass) for one address on Base or Ethereum in a single multicall, with human-readable amounts and USD values from Chainlink feeds

tools.name: tx
tools.description: Use when you need to confirm or explain a transaction (e.g. verify a payment arrived): fetches the transaction, its receipt and block from Base or Ethereum and returns success/failed/pending, confirmations, timestamp, from, to, native value, gas used and fee, the 4-byte method selector, contract cre

tools.name: ens
tools.description: Use before sending funds or when you only have a human-readable name: resolves ENS names (.eth and DNS names on ENS, including offchain/wildcard resolvers via CCIP-Read such as *.cb.id) and Basenames (*.base.eth, read directly on Base) to a checksummed address; or, given an address, returns its prim

tools.name: gas
tools.description: Use before sending a transaction or to tell a user what it will cost: reads eth_feeHistory over the last 20 blocks (10th/50th/90th percentile tips), the next base fee and gas price, on Base also the L1 data fee upper bound from the OP-stack GasPriceOracle, and prices typical actions (ETH transfer 21

tools.name: dex_price
tools.description: Use when a token has no Chainlink feed (long-tail, new or memecoins) and you need its current market price: finds every Uniswap v3 pool of the token against WETH, USDC (and USDT on Ethereum) across fee tiers, reads each pool's price (slot0) and reserves in one multicall, converts to USD with Chainli

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: price, balances, dex_price · Private data: token, balances, tx, dex_price · Public sink: ens.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: price, balances, dex_price · Private data: token, balances, tx, dex_price · Public sink: ens

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
